candidate_decisions.reason: The trusted channel evidence connects the focus's western encounter and two response options to supplied pericope evidence for environmental exposure, moral conduct, recompense, ease, and knowledge. Every nominated branch has a supplied focus or context carrier and an independent connection trigger.

The trusted solar-endpoint nomination has exact focus carriers for the sun, western setting, spring, and dark mud, and an exact eastern context carrier for rising and absent covering. The paired-arrival connection supplies an independent trigger for the changed exposure reading.

The exact HFT trace anchors capacity and means in 18:84, following in 18:85, and arrival in the focus. The three unresolved context branches are retained as attributed contextual evidence because their ayah, word index, root, role, and focus return are supplied.

The exact HFT trace preserves both the punitive and restraint facets at the focus and lands the conduct criteria and paired consequences in 18:87-88. The unresolved context branches remain attributed rather than being suppressed by registry status.

The exact HFT trace pairs the focus's spring and mud with the supplied eastern rising and absent covering, and the parallel arrival syntax supplies a distinct contrastive trigger. Its contextual branches are retained as attributed evidence.

The exact HFT trace returns through the focus's adopted good course and goodness word, then supplies corruption, assistance, breach repair, and mercy as a concrete pericope enactment. All unresolved context branches are retained with attributed application.

The exact HFT trace lands the focus's goodness branch and the supplied 18:98 evidence for mercy, a fixed promise, leveling, and truth. The trace supports a qualified durability boundary without requiring a branch gloss for its unresolved context records.

The surprising HFT trace has the exact punitive focus carrier and the exact repeated punitive context carrier in 18:87. The restraint facet survives as an attributed, contained disciplinary purpose alongside the supplied punitive core.

The surprising HFT trace gives the focus's dark mud and the later supplied blocks, fire, and molten copper exact carriers, with the barrier-construction connection returning the material comparison to the focus. Unresolved later branches remain attributed and bounded as analogy.

findings.title: Boundary conditions shape rule
findings.claim: The western encounter presents authority as a response calibrated to what the boundary and the people reveal: punishment and an adopted good course are differentiated forms of rule.
findings.mechanism: The focus carriers for the western setting, muddy spring, people, punishment, and adopted good meet the pericope's eastern exposure, moral consequences, recompense, ease, and knowledge; those contacts turn a bare grant of choice into conduct- and condition-sensitive action.
findings.reader_payoff: The scene becomes a test of how reach is used, with environmental exposure, moral conduct, and informed knowledge jointly shaping the response.
findings.containment: This is a bounded reading of the supplied pericope contacts. It does not establish a whole-surah system or choose either response as the sole meaning of the focus.

epistemic.reason: The channel supports are trusted and the relevant focus and context occurrences are explicitly supplied and connected within the declared pericope.

findings.title: Constructive good remains provisional
findings.claim: The good course can be effective mercy while remaining bounded by a promised future leveling, so constructive protection carries care without a claim to permanence.
findings.mechanism: The focus goodness carrier meets 18:98's mercy, fixed promise, leveling, and truth carriers; the later limit qualifies the duration of the constructive work without cancelling its positive evaluation.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can hold effective protection and acknowledged finitude together in the focus's good option.
findings.containment: This is an attributed inference from 18:98. The limit may concern the later barrier alone, and the finding does not turn provisionality into the focus's explicit translation.

epistemic.reason: The HFT trace supplies exact 18:86 and 18:98 contacts, while the claim that finitude qualifies the focus option is explicitly an inference.

findings.title: Punishment can contain restraint
findings.claim: The punitive option can carry restraint from further harm as a disciplinary purpose while painful punishment remains its primary reading.
findings.mechanism: The focus punitive form carries both the attributed withholding facet and the exact severe-punishment facet; 18:87 repeats the punitive root three times, allowing restraint to qualify the purpose without replacing the pain-bearing consequence.
findings.reader_payoff: Punishment is seen as an action that may restrain further harm as well as inflict a penalty, with both functions remaining visible.
findings.containment: This is an exploratory, legacy-unbound outlier. Restraint is not a replacement translation, and the repeated 18:87 punishment remains the containing context.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus and continuation traces are supplied, but the restraint facet is explicitly surprising and exploratory.

findings.title: Material changes mark two boundaries
findings.claim: The pericope can be heard moving from opaque mud and water at the western boundary to gathered, fired, and poured matter at the later controlled breach.
findings.mechanism: The focus's dark-mud carrier meets the later carriers for gathered blocks, kindled fire, and molten copper through the barrier-construction connection, changing unrelated material details into a bounded analogy between uncontrolled opacity and controlled repair.
findings.reader_payoff: The first boundary's muddy medium and the later barrier's worked materials become two distinct stages of matter encountered and shaped.
findings.containment: This is an exploratory attributed material analogy, not a claim that the spring predicts or becomes the barrier, and not a complete account of the later construction.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus and 18:96 word coordinates are supplied, but the cross-scene material analogy is explicitly exploratory and its later branch records are unresolved.

All nine supplied candidates and all seven assigned HFT records were reviewed. No uncandidate branch had an independently supplied trigger and materially changed reading beyond these retained dockets, so no exhaustive negative branch inventory was emitted.

The six external ayat 1:2-1:7 were quarantined during Phase 1 and reviewed only as a Phase 2 overlay. Their supplied cues add no branch-specific local carrier and trigger beyond the pericope's already grounded judgment, mercy, assistance, and guidance material, so no external overlay finding was admitted.
Unresolved HFT branch records are retained as attributed contextual evidence with null branch gloss and facet, preserving their exact supplied roles without inventing lexical content.
